note: Seafood and deli corner. Feminine nouns to the left of the green iron pillar (x=637), masculine to the right. The word abattoir is shown only as museum wall text on a blank plaque (not painted). The arch with hanging hams on the left goes back to the meat and fish stall; the arch with bread shelves on the right leads to the bakery.
